title: Mars Renaissance
description: The Mars Planet add to Minecraft!
body:
#Mars Renaissance Mod by Gardon

Have you always dreamed of going to Mars in the world of Minecraft? Download this mod and you'll finally have the chance!

#Mars Renaissance Mod About

The modification adds the ability to travel to Mars and explore new features such as new blocks, structures, items, mobs and a new boss!

#Mars Renaissance Mod Ending

The mod requires "GeckoLib" to work!
